correctness.rationale: The source eigenvalues lambda0=e^{-i(1-t)gamma}, lambdaj=-e^{i beta_j t} and on-shell mu=(k-1+(k+1)lambda)/(k+1+(k-1)lambda) imply exactly mu(k,e^{i phi})=(k+i tan(phi/2))/(k-i tan(phi/2)). For j>=1, cot(beta_j t/2)~2/(beta_j t), so mu_j tends to (beta_j xi-2i)/(beta_j xi+2i); beta_j=0 stays -1. Fixed finite alpha keeps j=0 away from singular -1 and mu0->1. Paired j,n-j modes are conjugate, so reflection is real; every nonconstant paired term (beta² xi²-4)/(beta² xi²+4) increases strictly, endpoints are negative to positive, and unique reflectionless xi_n follows. Independent direct double-scaling checks for n=3,4,7,10 and multiple xi confirm analytic limits; independent source verifier n=3..12 checks paired identities and xi3,xi4.
